visible.title: Perfect
visible.body: They fit perfectly without any modifications to either the car or the part; simply install them.

visible.author: MatthewB
visible.title: Black wheels? Nah...
visible.body: Love these red fuels with a -12 offset, really made a difference in my trucks looks. And yes the predator new mutants DO hum going down the road so forget those reviews saying they are quiet! Not bad but very noticable.
visible.product: Fuel Wheels Reaction Candy Red Milled Wheel; 17x9; -12mm Offset (20-26 Jeep Gladiator JT)

visible.author: Truckaccessory
visible.title: Aftermarket wheels
visible.body: The wheels are good quality and look great at the end results. Just be where you going to spend more money getting new lug nuts that fit those Wheels and if you have tire pressure sensor pieces you're going to have to order new ones for those Wheels. Almost another $250 to the installation at the shop
